property_summary: For every call to fallback sending exactly 10 ether at a strictly later timestamp, if block.number is divisible by 15 then the correct contract forwards its entire balance away (address(c).balance == 0), while the mutant that calls transfer(0) can leave a nonzero contract balance; the test fuzzes caller and timestamp to expose this difference.
change_summary: Replace transfer with sending zero value (no-op) so balance no longer forwarded, changing observable contract balance after fallback.
